name: Tetrahedral Splatting
definition: A point-based technique for real-time rendering of large tetrahedral meshes that renders tetrahedra with the help of a spherical or ellipsoid splat representation, using hierarchical data structures for efficient culling (e.g., back faces and occlusion).
summary: Tetrahedral Splatting is a real-time point-based rendering technique that approximates static unstructured tetrahedral meshes with spherical or ellipsoidal splats for efficient visualization.
